seo.title: Paje Surf Apartment | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: Affordable beachside apartment in Paje, Zanzibar’s kitesurfing capital. Includes a bicycle, kite storage, and is steps from the lagoon. From $55/night.

content:
This bright, breezy apartment is the ideal base for kitesurfers, budget-conscious travellers, and anyone drawn to Paje’s laid-back, salt-in-your-hair energy. Located on a quiet lane just a three-minute walk from the beach and the famous Paje kite lagoon, it puts you right in the heart of Zanzibar’s most vibrant beach-sport scene.

The space is simple but thoughtfully designed: a comfortable queen bed with crisp white linen, a compact kitchenette for morning coffee and quick meals, and a private balcony with a hammock that catches the ocean breeze. A complimentary bicycle makes it easy to explore the coast—ride south to the seaweed-farming village of Jambiani or north to the beach bars of Bwejuu. The shared rooftop terrace is a social hub at sunset, where fellow travellers swap stories over cold Kilimanjaro beers. It is not luxury, but it is exactly what Paje is about: sand between your toes, wind in the sail, and not a care in the world.
